ImageDescription.value: Nabu, sculpted bronze figure by Lee Lawrie. Door detail, east entrance, Library of Congress John Adams Building, Washington, D.C.

Credit.value: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division, LC-DIG-highsm-02782 (original digital file), uncompressed archival TIFF version (73 MB), cropped and converted to JPEG with the GIMP 2.4.5, image quality 88.

Artist.value: Artist is Lee Lawrie (1877–1963). Photographed 2007 by Carol Highsmith (1946–), who explicitly placed the photograph in the public domain.
